name: Eden
description: Eden lets agents research social posts, read cross-platform analytics, and draft and schedule posts, which wait for the user's approval. Each user signs in to their own Eden account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which posts in my niche performed best this week?
How did my posts perform across platforms last month?
Draft three post ideas from this article and save them in Eden.

apps.name: Eden
apps.description: Post research, analytics, drafts, and scheduling, over Eden's MCP server with browser sign-in.
